messages.content: Hello we are unable to issue a Y as per previous message but as the disputed read has been agreed I have archived this message. You will need to complete a dummy mex on your end for the COS date +1
hello we are still awaiting response, are you happy to verbally agree the reading

Hi, we are still waiting for response

We need to verbally agree the reading and then you will be able to complete a DMEX + 1 day from COS to update the new MSN with the agreed reading on install of the new meter.
